findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (passed 66-47)
findings.note: Voted no on second reading of HB 958. The ratified bill requires county boards to process a registration only if the applicant affirmatively states US citizenship, requires a sworn citizenship statement when the question is left blank, sets up removal of voters flagged as possible non-citizens from a federal database, and requires drivers license offices to proceed with a registration only if the applicant states citizenship. Bill page: https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookup/2025/H958 ; ratified text: https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, M11 Concur (vote to concur with Senate changes, passed 62-47)
findings.note: Voted no on concurring with the Senate version of HB 958, the final House vote before ratification. Bill page shows it was vetoed 08/17/2026 by the Governor (https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookup/2025/H958).
